purpose: D7-R versus fixed-action B0 control-chain diagnosis only; no training, checkpoint writes, formal evaluation, threshold decision, or R5 transition

conditions.action_semantics: fixed action through unchanged H1 governor, ICS, Lee, and rotor chain; not legacy direct-B0

cap_basis.time: 900 action seconds plus 10 cleanup seconds per separately identified condition; historical E0002 used 825.336833 allocated GPU seconds and 862.959676 wall seconds for 164800 transitions, leaving conservative headroom for lossless evidence I/O
cap_basis.disk: Eight selected lanes x 630 steps x 12x59x360 float32 actor lidar input is about 4.79 GiB per condition before metadata; 16 GiB aggregate is a fail-closed ceiling, not a target
cap_basis.starts: one independent identity, authorization, attempt, process, and simulator initialization per condition

signal_contract.known_limit: Lee/wrench post-step caches are invalid for lanes reset in that step because frozen product pre_reset does not retain them; those lanes are explicitly masked and remain NOT PROVEN

preconditions: A Commander/user approval must bind this exact proposal hash, both new experiment identities, aggregate caps, and zero retry
rlflow must be explicitly enabled by authorized control-plane action; current enabled=false is not changed by this proposal
two exact authorization JSON files must bind candidate commit/tree/config, product commit/tree, u0256 hash/source identity, condition, cases, attempt, and per-condition budget
both attempts must be fresh, results-empty, and non-symlinked; all STOP and coexistence gates must pass
candidate and frozen product/checkpoint must remain byte-exact and clean
submit D7-R and B0 at most once each; any uncertain launch, hash drift, cap breach, cleanup failure, or missing manifest stops without retry
no result may authorize R5 or modify acceptance thresholds
